model.note: The assistant cannot switch its own model; Phase 8 was implemented and reported under the runtime model.

design.approach: custom variable-height virtualizer (no virtualization dependency was present in package.json)
justification: The transcript is a flex column with row-gap 28px; a spacer-based layout reproduces the exact full content height (prefix[count]-gap) with two spacer divs, so scrollbar geometry, scroll-to-row offsets and the existing flex/gap styling are preserved without changing the DOM contract.

The logical window (Phase 2) already owns pagination, anchoring intent and session reset; the virtualizer only maps that window to a mounted sub-range, so a full table/measureElement abstraction was unnecessary surface area.
A hand-written pure geometry module (transcriptVirtual.mjs) is directly unit-testable in Node without a DOM (tests/transcriptVirtual.test.mjs).

Trade-off accepted: the team owns measurement/anchoring correctness. This is justified only because the tests below pin the exact invariants; a maintained library remains the safer default for a larger surface.
design.anchoring: The virtualizer owns scroll anchoring; useTranscriptWindow is called with anchoring:false to avoid double correction. Prepend restore is analytic (prefix[newIndex]-contentTop) with a mounted-DOM delta then scrollHeight fallback. Continuous height changes (streaming, images, sidebar reflow) are delegated to the browser native scroll anchoring.
design.boundedState: Expanded/collapsed row UI state lives in a bounded module-level Map keyed by stable identity (rowUiState.mjs), cleared on session change.

baselineReference.note: Phase 7 measured the un-virtualized non-truncating pagination tree with the same fixture and CDP methodology.

methodology: Same fixture (tests/fixtures/chatPagination.jsx) and CDP approach as Phase 7, in NODE_ENV=production, no engine/model launched, hardware acceleration disabled, 820x760 shown window, backgroundThrottling off. Differences: the expand loop drives the logical window via data-window-count and observes mounted rows via data-vt-mounted instead of waiting for every revealed message to be in the DOM. DOM count is querySelectorAll('*'). Heap is CDP JSHeapUsedSize after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage (retained JS heap, not RSS/GPU). Prepend time is the wall time to reveal one older page, including two rAFs. 120 programmatic scroll frames per sample. Three repetitions per size/content, fixed order, no statistical significance claimed. Absolute timings share an uncontrolled host; counts/heap are the stronger signals.

preservation.mechanism: No git reset/clean/stash/revert and no commit/push. Phase 8 only added files and extended existing files; no pre-existing file was deleted or replaced.
preExistingTrackedModified: src/components/ChatMessage.jsx (Phase 8 additions only, on top of the pre-existing working-tree diff)
preservation.untrackedNote: Every ?? entry in git status was present before Phase 8 except the new Phase 8 files listed under files.added.

extended: src/components/main-app/ChatInterface.jsx (virtualizer integration, data-window-*/data-vt-* attributes, find paint-effect deps)

complex600ScrollDetail.note: Phase 7 complex-600 scroll was p95 24.3ms with 0/360 frames over 50ms. The virtualized sweep keeps 5 mounted rows and 823 peak nodes, but some frames exceed 50ms because each fast programmatic jump mounts, parses and measures complex rows. This is a bounded, documented trade-off; real user scrolling is smoother than the 120-frame sinusoidal sweep.

checks.name: full-unit-suite
checks.detail: Failures are cloud/subagent/MCP/network-mock/assertion issues in suites unrelated to Phase 8 (no failing suite imports a changed Phase 8 module); not fixed per instructions.

limitations: No live model inference, no real streamed tool/cancellation trace, no multi-real-tab expanded-history timing, no long soak.
Programmatic scroll sweep is harsher than user scrolling (large sinusoidal jumps every frame).
Retained JS heap via CDP is not RSS/GPU memory; native image memory not measured.
Synthetic message complexity is reproducible but not the user real histories.
messageMetadata.ui.cjs produced no stdout on the passing run (exit 0); its console summary was not captured.
decision: Phase 8 virtualization is implemented and bounded as designed. Keep the custom virtualizer; the measured DOM/heap/reveal reductions are large and the invariants are pinned by tests. Stop for review; no commit/push.
